objections.claim: The Phase-1a installation contract is internally unsatisfiable. Section 1 requires externally supplied node/git/bwrap/gh binaries and their authenticated closures, while Section 4 ships only a source archive, requires host-provided tools, simultaneously says every spawned tool resolves inside the install root, and makes any clean-room spawn outside that root fail. The out-of-band trust-root manifest schema contains no tool or closure digests, and no release artifact provisions the pinned tool root. Consequently doctor/verify cannot both use the required host tools and satisfy the claimed identity/root-confinement checks. Define and ship an authenticated toolchain-root artifact, or explicitly admit operator tools through a digest-bound external-tool contract and update the trust manifest and clean-room oracle accordingly.

The authoritative-tool integrity mechanism does not authenticate the complete executed closure it claims. It reduces that closure to the main ELF, PT_INTERP, and transitive DT_NEEDED libraries, but Git can execute separate git-* programs and protocol helpers during fetch operations; those are executable verdict-producing bytes, not ELF dependencies ([Git remote-helper contract](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitremote-helpers)). Runtime-loaded trust/configuration inputs are likewise outside the stated enumeration. A substituted helper can therefore fabricate fetched objects while every listed digest remains valid. Closure construction must recursively include every exec edge and verdict-affecting runtime input, fail on unresolved acquisition, and include substitution regressions for non-DT_NEEDED helpers.
